newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex raised to buy.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co said on Friday it had upgraded its Cemex SA's recommendation to a buy rating from neutral.
-- Oppenheimer said in an analysis the upgrade was based on "our expectation of an eight percent EBITDA growth through 1999.

--"We believe Cemex will participate fully in the Mexican infrastructure recovery, maintaining its market share at about 60 percent while increasing capacity utilization and redirecting exports to the domestic market at substantially higher margins."
